goal: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with d2/d3, exact complete state/logits/output and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total metrics

budget.scope: Remove repeated activation/codebook staging over output groups. Family duration and structural byte counts are opportunity bounds, not projected timing savings; the full goal is unchanged.

history: The rejected v9 combined persistent FP8 plus replicated codebook, NV Gate/Up, batched target head and ordered draft attention. It did not independently reject Gate/Up. The head and ordered draft later passed separate API compositions. This fixed successor isolates Gate/Up input lifetime on current exact paired weights/live reductions and v48 row boundaries. No rejected FP8 executor or decoder change is reintroduced.
composition: Keep existing capped-three-row shared activation and paired shared codebooks live across disjoint output groups. Each warp owns the same four output channels and all original K chains; only its outer output loop changes. Down, head, FP8, Attention and state are unchanged.

grid_contract.rule: For each M2/M3/M4, constructor sets max-shared carveout, queries cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor once for the frozen kernel, and publishes grid = active_blocks * 16. No per-request query, timing feedback or scan. Private atomic host slots avoid races between equivalent constructors; uninitialized plans reject before enqueue.
grid_contract.pre_gpu_static_revision: Initial incumbent-based 80/64/48 estimates were replaced before any GPU admission because persistent-loop compilation changed register counts to 70/96/123 and driver-reserved shared memory also affects occupancy. Resource-derived whole-wave planning removes this assumption rather than testing grid variants.

structural_input_staging.semantics: Shared-input staging requests only, not measured DRAM traffic. Original inputs remain read-only and all weights are still consumed.
structural_input_staging.new_formula: grid(M3) * 3 * 5120 * 2; grid is recorded by native resource admission

full P65 scalar-prefix state/logit/cache and recovery admission
immediate P65/8K/40K d2 API; >3% slowdown stops; neutral removes; useful d2 unlocks d3
expiry: Immediate API selects removal or bounded dependency through next complete verifier API return or archival. Production and the 8-GiB reserve unchanged.
